description: This Java class defines a domain entity named ProcessingJob for a receipt and expense management platform. It models an asynchronous processing task, such as OCR or categorization, with relevant metadata and status tracking. The class uses Spring Data annotations for MongoDB integration, including indexes and document mapping.

classes.name: ProcessingJob
classes.description: Represents an asynchronous document processing job with status, parameters, and results. Can be OCR, extraction, or categorization tasks.
